§ 01About

Design is not decoration. It is how people understand products.

I’m a UI/UX Designer and Front-End Developer who combines research, visual design, and modern development to create experiences that are beautiful, functional, and scalable. My practice runs through Figma, Webflow, WordPress, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and mature design systems.

§ 02Experience — In Four Chapters
Chapter 01
2019 — 2021

Learning Design

First lines in Figma. Grids, contrast, hierarchy. Reading Müller-Brockmann on trains and re-drawing icons until they felt inevitable.

Chapter 02
2021 — 2022

Building Websites

From static HTML into WordPress and Elementor. Learning that a website is an argument for restraint, not decoration.

Chapter 03
2022 — 2024

Working with Clients

Translating messy briefs into calm interfaces for founders, small teams, and travel operators across four continents.

Chapter 04
2024 — Now

Creating Digital Products

End-to-end product work: research, systems, motion, and the front-end that ships it. Fewer, better screens.
